description: This file defines a Flutter widget for an Android TV optimized login screen with DPAD navigation, focus management, and on-screen keyboard interaction.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the login screen UI for Android TV platforms.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing focus, input, and navigation logic for the login screen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes focus nodes and sets initial focus on the username tile.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes focus nodes when widget is removed.

methods.name: _requestNext
methods.description: Requests focus to move to the next node.

methods.name: _requestPrev
methods.description: Requests focus to move to the previous node.

methods.name: _handleDpadTraversal
methods.description: Handles DPAD navigation and select button presses.

methods.name: _editValueWithKeyboard
methods.description: Displays on-screen keyboard overlay for field entry and updates the corresponding state.

methods.name: _passwordPreview
methods.description: Returns a masked preview for password field.

methods.name: _focusableTile
methods.description: Builds a focusable ListTile row for user input fields with focus styling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the overall UI of the login screen with focus management and layout.
